description: A1808 (B2833, D1202 section 3): the 20 invariants of the parameter core as checks on the run trace (A1719). Limits are placeholders for the TL (B2649). An invariant the trace cannot show yet has kind 'not_measurable' and names what is missing - the night report lists it, so the gap stays visible. Moods, traits and the will to live are in the snapshots since GW4 #554; limits of inv05/13/19 are placeholders too.

invariants.text: Every value in range, no NaN
Same seed plus log gives the same state hash
invariants.missing: checked by the replay of each reference run (reference_runs.py), not from the trace

invariants.text: No layer reads from a higher one in the same tick
invariants.missing: a static check of the dependency graph (code), not a run

invariants.text: Every world change has a core action as its cause; AI and player write guesses <= 0.3
invariants.missing: beliefs with source and confidence in the trace

invariants.text: No feeling above 0.6 for more than 3 h once its trigger is gone (triggers are not in the trace: every stretch counts)
The same failed action on the same thing at most 3 times a day
Every lock has a reachable release and is never older than 24 h
invariants.missing: cause-bound locks do not exist yet (D1203 step 2)

invariants.text: At most 6 changes of plan per hour; no A-B-A-B over 2 rounds
Confidence never rises through a message whose chain holds the receiver
invariants.missing: the provenance chain of knowledge (D1203 layer 3)

invariants.text: Confidence above 0.8 only with own confirmation or 2 independent sources
invariants.missing: beliefs with source and confidence in the trace

invariants.text: Critical body value plus known reachable remedy: the remedy is the plan within N ticks
invariants.missing: which action serves which need is in the data, but known and reachable remedies are not in the trace

invariants.text: At least 5 h sleep in the 3-day mean (no sleep on wet ground: not in the trace yet)
Cold raises frustration only with a second need below its threshold
No inhabitant awake longer than 30 min without a plan
Every new kind of thing has a log entry with its sources and core rule
Every AI job stays in its token budget; every named thing maps to an id
invariants.missing: token counts are in the service call logs (prompt_tokens), not in the trace

invariants.text: Every memory list stays below its cap
invariants.missing: memory list sizes in the snapshots

invariants.text: The character never changes after birth
Will to live changes only at night and never sinks when all body needs were met
Long run: trait spread per generation >= 50 % of the start; enough variety of actions
